guidance.useWhen: Use for repeated utility actions such as refresh, close, clear, and similar compact commands.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for destructive or primary business actions without visible text.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Do not create unlabeled icon-only controls.

limitations: Icon-only actions require an accessible label that communicates the action.

accessibility.notes: Every icon-only button must have an accessible label.
